$description: Mangayomi design tokens, derived from tokens.css. Colour values are a reference instantiation of the shipped defaults (FlexColor.blue, blend 10, pure black off); the runtime contract is the role mapping in DESIGN.md section 3. Non colour tokens are authoritative.

color.$description: Runtime bound. See DESIGN.md section 3.1 for the Flutter accessor each role maps to.

surface-warm.$description: B slot alias: single surface tier.

fg-2.$description: B slot alias: two level ramp only.

muted.$description: Not a distinct colour at runtime: fg at alpha.secondary. Dark reference #a6abb0.

meta.$description: B slot alias: no third text tier.

accent-on.$description: COMPUTED, never authored: accent.computeLuminance() > 0.5 ? black : white. Flips to #000000 in the dark reference because that accent is the pale blue.

danger.$description: Prefer colorScheme.error at runtime. Dark reference #ffb4ab.

alpha.$description: The alpha ladder. Tints are an alpha over color.fg or color.accent so they survive any palette. Applied with Color.withValues(alpha:). Six values; a seventh must be promoted in DESIGN.md first.

tint.$description: over fg: chip and neutral badge fill

accent-tint.$description: over accent: accent tinted badge fill

tv-focus.$description: over accent: ambient focusColor, TV only

disabled.$description: Dimmed means alpha 0.5 in 24 places, 0.6 in 7 and 0.38 in 2 today. Material's value, because disabled text has a contrast floor 0.5 does not clear on every palette.

tint.$description: The alpha ladder pre-composed for CSS consumers, so a percentage is never retyped. Dart applies the raw alpha.* value with Color.withValues(alpha:) instead.

font.$description: Never named in Dart: appFontFamily is user selectable. Recorded so previews render.

text.$description: Compact scale. Steps are 1px apart, so weight carries hierarchy.

5xl.$description: Screen title that carries a page

6xl.$description: The one big moment per screen

numeric.$description: reserved for a number inside a filled pill

display.$description: Display headings; distinct from title at 700

sm.$description: hand built badges, pills, chips, covers

md.$description: cards with their own ink surface

pill.$description: real Material Chip and TextField, set by FlexSubThemesData

2xl.$description: Sheets; softer than the 2018 Material card

cover.$description: Manga and anime covers are 2:3 at every size.

ring-width.$description: accent ring on the anchor item, the only brand coloured border

max-columns.$description: The shipped size slider runs well past the old value of 2

ring-width.$description: TV only onSurface ring on Text/Elevated/Filled buttons

track.$description: Letter-spacing. Roboto's default is tuned for body text and goes slack above 24px, so large type must set this explicitly.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur radii. A blurred surface must never sit inside a layer that forces an offscreen (a Transform with filterQuality does): the blur then samples that layer instead of the page and silently stops working.

mark.$description: Progress, unread and offline. The app's real subject matter, and previously undescribed. A cover carrying no marks is finished, which is the resting state.

progress-h.$description: hairline along the foot of a cover

offline.$description: Deliberately NOT the accent: a fact about the file, not an invitation

ease.$description: Easing. Every curve in the app is currently written at the call site, so no two agree.

density.$description: The four display modes share no vocabulary today, so each screen re-decides its own gaps.

elev.$description: Explicit shadow. Material 3 tonal elevation does most of the work, so these are rare and shallow. Cast outside any clip: a clipped child cannot paint past its own bounds.

glass.$description: Translucent chrome over content. Nearly opaque in light themes, where there is nothing dark behind for the blur to pull in.

glass-light.$description: A light theme has nothing dark behind for the blur to pull in, so translucency alone leaves the bar invisible against the page.

skeleton.$description: Loading placeholders. The tint is the theme foreground at low alpha, never a fixed grey.

radius.$description: matches the cover it stands in for

icon.$description: Seven sizes are in use on Icon widgets across lib/modules today (14, 16, 18, 19, 20, 24, 30) with no rule, plus 56 and 140 for empty-state illustrations, which are not controls. These three are the intended scale.

tap.$description: Interaction floors. height: 40 appears 7 times in lib/modules; the ones that are interactive are under both.
